• *CANNOT evidence:* implementation or passing results, compatibility, production/security performance, or regulatory acceptance.
• *Dedup:* do not use the later carrier-only `B1421-{DOMAIN}-{VARIANT}` result as canonical; it states durability pending and clause mapping blocked.
• *Addenda delta:* add two-site/shared-instance, iOS+Android, named models, QA controls, three CMDP families/preflight, and Addendum-4 NetDMR schema cases.
*Production delivery gate — all must be measured before “ready”*
1. Implement/run the addenda-complete acceptance corpus with durable case-level receipts.
2. Production auth, least-privilege RBAC, immutable audit, session/access review, threat model, dependency/secret scans, and required independent NIST/FedRAMP evidence.
3. Cloud architecture for two labs: encryption, monitoring/alerts, backup restore drills, RTO/RPO, DR/failover, capacity/concurrency/load evidence.
4. iOS+Android offline fault testing: sync conflicts, interruption, replay, device clock, data-at-rest, loss/recovery.
5. Real interface validation for each named instrument, subcontract lab, Power BI, CMDP, and NetDMR using approved protocols/schemas and golden round trips.
6. Release evidence: traceable build, environment/config inventory, deployment/rollback runbook, training/support/SLA, operational acceptance, and authorized sign-off.
*Current gate: HOLD / BUILD-AND-VERIFY.* Production is the target; synthetic proof is the starting artifact. No production-ready claim until every applicable gate has durable evidence.

_Bid 1421 — Addendum 3 static workbook review (no macros run)_

The CMDP sample-result workbook has three upload tabs: _Microbial_, _Chems-Rads_, and _Cryptosporidium_, plus a Notes/changelog sheet.

All three templates use a required _Reporting Lab ID_ and a “Sample Information” block where red-asterisk fields are required for the record to exist. The common visible intake fields include sample ID, sample received date, WSID, facility ID, sampling point ID/location, collection date and 24-hour collection time, sample type, and sample volume; templates also expose repeat/original-sample and original-reporting-lab lineage fields.

_Cryptosporidium-specific visible fields:_ Comment, Sample Collector Name, and required _Analyte [Code – Name]_.

Engineering implication: build an export preflight that rejects records missing required fields, preserves original/repeat lineage, supports all three report families separately, and validates dropdown/code values before creating a CMDP upload. No claim of actual CMDP certification/integration until validated with the City/state workflow.

_BILLINGS BID 1421 — ADDENDA RECEIVED / IMPLEMENTATION BRIEF_

Cheri sent Addenda 1, 2, 4, and 5 plus the Addendum 3 CMDP sample-result workbook. Treat the following as the controlling implementation/proposal facts:

• Deployment: _Big Bang_; _cloud_ subscription preference; one shared instance serving _two laboratory locations_. Start fresh — _no data migration_.
• Capacity: ~_5,000 samples/year_; _6 named users_, _2–3 concurrent_; _6 field samplers_.
• Mobile: offline field workflow is required on _both iOS and Android_.
• Instrument scope to plan/test against: Metrohm Eco IC; Seivers M5310C; Seal Analytical AQ300; Perkin Elmer PinAAcle 900Z.
• Other integration scope: one subcontracted lab; _Power BI_ interface; otherwise no integrations stated.
• QA expectations: control charts; batch-level QC scheduling/tracking; thermometer & pipet verification; instrument maintenance; temperature tracking.
• Regulatory reporting: CMDP _5–10 unique uploads/week_; NetDMR: _one plant, one DMR/month_. Addendum 4’s NetDMR template governs its record fields.
• Timeline: anticipated award _Sep 28_; desired go-live _February 2027_. Full contract negotiations occur with vendor of choice.
_Immediate work split_
1. Build/prototype: configure the synthetic proof around two sites/shared tenancy, offline field queue, six samplers, named instruments, custody→QC→reporting traceability.
2. QA/reporting: produce test fixtures for the above QC controls and both reporting formats. Addendum 3 is an `.xlsm`: _static schema/content inspection only — do not enable or execute macros_.
3. Proposal: map each claimed capability to an evidence artifact and flag every post-award dependency. Do not call the prototype production-ready or claim certified instrument integrations.
No one contacts the City or sends a submission from this thread; route findings here for consolidation.
